summary: Adversarial testing found two input-validation defects and one symlink-write defect. The new tests prove the Kim-panel privacy boundary and expose invalid-input cases.
blocking_findings: F1 [Blocker] adversarial-testing: scripts/mom-kim-sheet.mjs accepts missing, stale, extra, and string-valued rows.lit data, overwrites measure.json from image masks, and writes both sheets instead of issuing a named error. A missing rows.lit fixture exits 0 and leaves two PNGs. Rationale: AC5 rule 4 makes measure.json the pinned source for lit rows and requires invalid input to stop before output.

F2 [Blocker] adversarial-testing: scripts/mom-kim-sheet.mjs accepts a fully transparent Kim sheet and writes both sheets. Its nonWhite scan ignores alpha, so a blank reference can reach the local review. Rationale: AC5 requires the Kim reference scan to reject invalid figure bands before producing the review sheet.
nonblocking_findings: F3 [Major] adversarial-testing: scripts/mom-kim-sheet.mjs writes measure.json, mom-kim-review.png, and mom-panel.png through a symlink at out/chibi-sprouts/redesign. A temp-root symlink probe exited 0 and placed all three files in the symlink target. Rationale: output writes must stay within the two planned PNG paths and must not follow symlinks.
evidence: The exact phase diff contains plan.md, generated status, scripts/mom-kim-sheet.mjs, and tests/mom-kim-sheet.test.ts.

The targeted Red sheet test passed 8 of 8. The project gate passed 238 files, 3462 tests, and skipped 27 tests across 4 skipped files.
A five-pixel shifted Kim sheet, a one-band Kim sheet, a blank Kim sheet, and a smaller Kim sheet each exited 1 with one named Kim-row line and wrote no sheet.
A fully transparent Kim sheet exited 0 and wrote both PNGs. This reproduces the transparent-alpha defect.

Missing rows.lit, stale rows, extra rows, and string rows each exited 0 and wrote both PNGs. Missing rows.lit was replaced in measure.json. Malformed JSON exited 1 before output with a JSON parse error.
A symlink at the output directory received measure.json and both PNGs. The script exited 0.
An injected Kim image in mom-panel.png passed the original Red test suite, 8 of 8. The new exact-render comparison failed on the same mutant.
Removing the 4 px tolerance let the original Red tests pass with a five-pixel-shifted Kim source. The new shifted-row test failed on that mutant.
The Red suite failed on baseline offset, 600 px scale, and Mom side drawing mutants. The caption-pass mutant passed the old suite and failed the new rendered-caption test.
The new adversarial test file has 5 cases. Three passed and two failed against the audited implementation: fully transparent Kim and missing rows.lit.
